sight, the lame walk, but then he went one step further. He took up our plight
as our kinsman Redeemer. He bore our sins for us on the cross and there on the
cross he suffered chapter 34 on our behalf. Jesus didn't like go somewhere to
descend into hell. No, he descended into hell on the cross as all of God's
everlasting wrath was poured out on his eternal Son and he suffered for us there
though he knew no sin himself. And he paid it. He paid it in full, not even a cent of
the ransom left to be paid. Having suffered our punishment he tasted death
for us, but death could not hold him. And three days later he got up from the dead
with everlasting life. Friends, here is why faith brings us to joy rather than
judgment because your faith is in God's Son, Jesus Christ, the kinsman,
Redeemer, the one who has borne the judgment for us and paid it all. If God
did not vindicate our faith in Him, then God would be unjust. If God did not bring
us to joy in Him, then God would not have loved His Son. But friends, God is
just and God loves His Son. Today is the day to turn away from your trust in
other things, to put your faith in Christ, that He might lead you through His
judgment to everlasting joy. Why would you settle for lesser joys now if they cost
you eternal joy on the last day when Jesus Christ appears? God will, He will
vindicate faith in his son on the last day. The question is will he vindicate you?
Let's pray. Father, our minds stagger. We cannot get our minds around the
extraordinary contrast between what we deserve and what you promise to give us
Christ, simply for faith. Everything in us wants to do something, to earn that, to
add to Christ, and yet you call us to trust in Him alone and to trust in Him
utterly. Father, we pray that you would open blind eyes, our eyes. We pray that you
open, stopped ears, deaf ears like ours, that we might see and hear Jesus in all
of his beauty as he invites us now into his kingdom. And we pray that we would
continue to see and continue to hear and continue to live now as those who have
entered into that life already so that when the last day comes it is but a
transition from life into life and we ask this in Christ's name amen
